name: Who Stole My Beer?
description: Buy a Beer Can, use the returned Empty Beer Can for Spider Crab and bring the required result back for the boat key.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the Lighthouse starting area

sections.heading: Steps
bullets: Buy a Beer Can and give it to the Lighthouse Keeper.
Equip the returned Empty Beer Can on the Crab Fishing Rod.
Defeat Spider Crab and keep the quest result.
Return it to the keeper for the boat key, then buy the $10 Radar.

sections.heading: Common blocker
paragraphs: The kill alone does not complete the route. Pick up the correct quest result and finish the return dialogue before expecting the next coordinates.

name: Dinnertime & the Leech Route
description: Complete the lady's request, collect three ground leeches and turn the resulting Leech Bait into the Giant Piranha trophy.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the Forest Island route

sections.heading: Steps
bullets: Speak to the lady by the lake and complete the active dinner request.
Pick up three leeches from the island ground.
Trade them for Leech Bait.
Defeat Giant Piranha, then return its named trophy for Desert Island coordinates.

sections.heading: Spawn warning
paragraphs: Leeches are ground pickups rather than ordinary fish-table catches. If too few appear, revisit dialogue and reload the island instead of wasting a lure in the water.

name: Vacation & Pufferfish Route
description: Catch Needlefish, trade it for a Carrot, defeat Pufferfish and return the fin for Rocks Island coordinates.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of the Pufferfish boss battle

sections.heading: Steps
bullets: Catch Needlefish with the Standard Lure.
Give it to the tourist under the tree for a Carrot.
Use the Carrot to summon Pufferfish.
Return the Pufferfish fin to unlock Rocks Island.

sections.heading: Separate achievement
paragraphs: Vacation also asks you to help the tourist swim. Complete the physical water interaction while the tourist route is active and wait for the Steam unlock confirmation.

name: Grillmaster & Blue Shark
description: Use the $280 Standard Boss Lure, bring Blue Shark to the Grillmaster and unlock the 1.5× cooking route.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot of players using an island grill

sections.heading: Steps
bullets: Buy Standard Boss Lure for $280.
Summon and defeat Blue Shark.
Bring the body to the Grillmaster.
Start the grill to unlock the achievement and cooking loop.

sections.heading: Cooking rule
paragraphs: Cooking can raise the inspected item value to about 1.5×. Pull it away at the peak: once an item burns black, its value drops to zero.

name: Terrorizing Bird
description: Turn a Professional Boss Lure into Tuna, use the body as Albatross bait and return the bird's head for Volcano coordinates.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot showing a bird above an island

sections.heading: Steps
bullets: Buy Professional Boss Lure for $1,200.
Defeat Tuna and keep the body.
Place it on the ground to draw in Albatross.
Defeat the bird and return its head for Volcano coordinates.

sections.heading: Common blocker
paragraphs: Do not sell, cook or consume the Tuna before the second encounter. It is a physical trigger item, not just a completed encyclopedia entry.

name: Deadliest Catch & Final Whale Route
description: Help the military, use the whale trigger and finish the two-stage Bowhead Whale ending chain.
imageAlt: Official How to Fish screenshot used for the final military and whale route

sections.heading: Steps
bullets: Complete the military dialogue and large-creature objective.
Use Fish Bucket / Whale Bait for Bowhead Whale.
Keep the defeated whale for the mutated encounter.
Defeat Mutated Bowhead Whale and take the final transport to finish the story.

sections.heading: Completion note
paragraphs: The credits return you to the game with the islands available for collection cleanup. Save Handyman and Bean for dedicated challenge runs.
